nodes.summary: A point of the complex affine plane is a pair $a = (a_0, a_1)$ of complex numbers, that is, an element of $\mathbb{C}^2$, with coordinates indexed by $0$ and $1$.
nodes.title: Points of the complex affine plane

nodes.summary: For every configuration $x = (x_0, \dots, x_9)$ of ten points of $\mathbb{C}^2$, not necessarily distinct, the affine Seshadri constant of $x$ is at most $1$.
nodes.title: The affine Seshadri constant is at most one

nodes.summary: For a configuration $x = (x_0, \dots, x_9)$ of ten points of $\mathbb{C}^2$, not necessarily distinct, the affine Seshadri constant of $x$ is the infimum of the ratios $\deg f / \sum_{i=0}^{9} \operatorname{mult}_{x_i} f$ over all nonzero polynomials $f \in \mathbb{C}[X_0, X_1]$ with $\sum_{i=0}^{9} \operatorname{mult}_{x_i} f > 0$, where $\deg f$ is the total degree of $f$ and $\operatorname{mult}_{x_i} f$ is the…
nodes.title: Seshadri constant of ten affine points

nodes.summary: The generic ten-point Seshadri constant of $\mathbb{P}^2$, in the affine-chart model, is at least $55/174$.
nodes.title: Ciliberto–Miranda lower bound for the ten-point Seshadri constant

nodes.summary: The generic ten-point Seshadri constant of $\mathbb{P}^2$, in the affine-chart model, is at least $4/13$.
nodes.title: Eckl's 2008 lower bound for the ten-point Seshadri constant

nodes.summary: The generic ten-point Seshadri constant of $\mathbb{P}^2$, in the affine-chart model, is at least $117/370$.
nodes.title: Eckl's 2011 lower bound for the ten-point Seshadri constant

nodes.summary: The generic ten-point Seshadri constant is the supremum, over all configurations $x = (x_0, \dots, x_9)$ of ten pairwise distinct points of $\mathbb{C}^2$, of the affine Seshadri constant of $x$.
nodes.title: Generic ten-point Seshadri constant

nodes.summary: The generic ten-point Seshadri constant of $\mathbb{P}^2$, in the affine-chart model, is at least $177/560$.
nodes.title: Harbourne–Roé lower bound for the ten-point Seshadri constant

nodes.summary: The total degree of the exponent vector $m = (m_0, m_1)$ of a monomial $X_0^{m_0} X_1^{m_1}$ in two variables is $m_0 + m_1$.
nodes.title: Total degree of a monomial

nodes.summary: For every point $a = (a_0, a_1) \in \mathbb{C}^2$, the polynomial $X_0 - a_0 \in \mathbb{C}[X_0, X_1]$, which defines the line through $a$ on which the first coordinate is constant, has multiplicity $1$ at $a$.
nodes.title: The first-coordinate line through a point has multiplicity one there

nodes.summary: For a polynomial $f \in \mathbb{C}[X_0, X_1]$ and a point $a = (a_0, a_1) \in \mathbb{C}^2$, the multiplicity of $f$ at $a$ is the least total degree of a monomial occurring with nonzero coefficient in the translated polynomial $f(X_0 + a_0, X_1 + a_1)$. For the zero polynomial it is $0$.
nodes.title: Multiplicity of a plane polynomial at a point

nodes.summary: The proposition that the generic ten-point Seshadri constant of $\mathbb{P}^2$, in the affine-chart model, equals $1/\sqrt{10}$.
nodes.title: Nagata's conjecture for ten points

nodes.summary: A plane polynomial is a polynomial $f \in \mathbb{C}[X_0, X_1]$ in two variables $X_0, X_1$ with complex coefficients.
nodes.title: Polynomials in two complex variables

nodes.summary: The ten-point Seshadri constant is the generic ten-point Seshadri constant: the supremum, over all configurations of ten pairwise distinct points of $\mathbb{C}^2$, of their affine Seshadri constants.
nodes.title: Ten-point Seshadri constant

nodes.summary: For a configuration $x = (x_0, \dots, x_9)$ of ten points of $\mathbb{C}^2$, not necessarily distinct, the Seshadri ratios of $x$ are the real numbers $\deg f / \sum_{i=0}^{9} \operatorname{mult}_{x_i} f$, where $f$ ranges over the nonzero polynomials in $\mathbb{C}[X_0, X_1]$ with $\sum_{i=0}^{9} \operatorname{mult}_{x_i} f > 0$, $\deg f$ is the total degree of $f$, and $\operatorname{mult}_{x_i} f$ is the…
nodes.title: Seshadri ratios of ten points

nodes.summary: For a polynomial $f \in \mathbb{C}[x_1, x_2]$ and a point $a = (a_1, a_2) \in \mathbb{C}^2$, the translate of $f$ by $a$ is the polynomial $f(x_1 + a_1, x_2 + a_2)$, obtained by substituting $x_i + a_i$ for $x_i$. It moves the point $a$ to the origin.
nodes.title: Translate of a plane polynomial

nodes.summary: The generic ten-point Seshadri constant of $\mathbb{P}^2$, in the affine-chart model, is at most $1/\sqrt{10}$.
nodes.title: Submaximal upper bound for the ten-point Seshadri constant

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
